subject: Missituck Elementary Geothermal HVAC Selection
overview: The MPS School Committee reviewed after-school programming and infrastructure updates, voting to select a geothermal HVAC system for Missituck Elementary and approving a Construction Manager at Risk model for Roberts Elementary. The committee also received a first-quarter financial update.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, including bills and payrolls, meeting minutes, donations, and a quarterly collaborative update.

items.title: Personnel Statement and Mustang Moment
items.summary: Superintendent Suzanne Galusi addressed a personnel vetting matter published in the news media, after which Roberts Elementary after-school students presented a video on their cardboard chair design challenge.

items.title: Before and After School Program Update
items.summary: Managing Director Katie Doucette presented an operational update on district after-school programs, highlighting a 50 percent increase in enrollment, reduced waitlists, and new student support positions.

items.title: Missituck Elementary Feasibility Study
items.summary: The committee selected Option 2, a ground-source geothermal heat pump system, for the Missituck Elementary Accelerated Repair Project following a review of building energy usage and long-term costs.

items.title: Roberts Elementary CMR Application
items.summary: The committee approved utilizing a Construction Manager at Risk delivery method for the Roberts Elementary School repair project.

items.title: First Quarter Financial Update
items.summary: Finance Director Noel Velez presented the first-quarter budget report, outlining spending, encumbrances, and risk management in special education transportation and facility heating costs.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the family of Arvin Halliday and observed a moment of silence.
